text:
“Europe, said Merz, had ‘no interest in a trade conflict (with Trump). On the contrary, we think trade benefits everyone and tariffs damage everyone… But if he wants this conflict, then we will have to give the right answer’.”
Just a reminder, what Trump is proposing is equal tariffs. If Europe wants no tariffs all they have to do is eliminate all the tariffs they are currently imposing against us. And if "tariffs damage everyone" like he says then this seems like a simple problem for them. Right, Merz?
